newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 1.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finance Minister N'Goran Niamien winds up a seminar on public spending by announcing a crackdown on inefficiency, bureaucracy and corrupt practices within the public sector.
- The Japanese ambassador says his government, which funded the newly-inaugurated fishing port at San Pedro, is also looking at reviving the port at Sassandra. No decision has been taken yet.
- Bank SGBCI announces that it is cutting its base rate to 9.0 percent from 9.50 percent.
- The national assembly voted on Thursday to make it easier for private sector companies to develop urban sites.
